prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: high-resolution isolated bag mockup for a professional live 2D product configurator.
Create a NEW clean blank studio mockup using the detailed geometry specification below, with no branding or print.
Primary request: A premium unprinted neutral ivory/light-grey non-woven polypropylene reusable bag, with fine believable bonded non-woven texture, crisp professionally finished seams, smooth broad frontal printing surface, subtle natural edge creases, and a complete clean silhouette.
Style/medium: exceptionally polished realistic commercial product-mockup illustration with photographic material detail, suited to large on-screen zoom.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely TRANSPARENT background with an actual alpha channel. The background and every visible handle opening must be fully transparent, NOT white pixels and NOT a drawn checkerboard.
Composition/framing: one single bag only, centered, straight-on FRONT view at bag mid-height with parallel verticals; extremely slight right gusset visibility only where the bag has a gusset; do not use a strongly angled three-quarter view. Broad flat front surface is essential for placing customer artwork. Square 1536 by 1536 pixels or best available high resolution. Entire subject including handles/strings fits within the frame and occupies about 75% of total image height. At least 8% clear padding on every side.
Lighting/mood: soft even studio light from upper left, restrained soft shading on the bag itself, subtle dimensional depth. No floor, no plinth, no environment, no cast background shadow; the website adds its own shadow.
Color palette: consistently light neutral ivory tending toward light grey; nearly monochrome, minimal yellow warmth; identical color for all fabric, seams, and handles. Neutral luminance detail designed for runtime color tinting.
Constraints: NO typography, NO logos, NO labels, NO watermarks, NO artwork, NO decorative piping, NO extra objects. Blank material across the whole front. Premium crisp detailed edges with true alpha antialiasing. Preserve all of each handle and bag silhouette.
Subject geometry: D-CUT bag. A flat upright rectangular non-woven sleeve-like body, slightly taller than wide, with a single horizontally elongated oval/die-cut hand hole centered in a reinforced top band. The oval hole passes through the bag and reveals true transparent background. Clean straight bottom seam and flat side edges. NO loop handles, NO extended straps, NO gusset, NO drawstrings.
